newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Demir-Halk Bank secures 50 mln mark loan.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Demir-Halk Bank secures 50 mln mark loan.

text.p: Turkey's Rotterdam-based Demir-Halk Bank secured a 50 million-mark syndicated loan, the bank's general manager Merdan Aziz said in a statement.
"The (one-year) loan carries an interest rate of LIBOR plus 75 basis points and it will be used to finance Turkey's imports from the European countries," Merdan Araz said.
The loan was arranged by Standard & Chartered Bank London and Westdeutsche Landesbank Dusseldorf.
Demir-Halk Bank is a joint-venture of Turkey's statebank Halkbank and private Demirbank. It has been operating in the Netherlands since 1993.
The statement said the bank had already received an approval from the Dutch officials to open a branch in Dusseldorf.
